lizard.purpose: cyclomatic complexity, lines and parameters per function (TS, JS, PHP, Go, Java and more)

stryker.install: npm install --save-dev @stryker-mutator/core (plus the runner: @stryker-mutator/jest-runner or @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner), then npx stryker init

infection.install: composer require --dev infection/infection (needs pcov or Xdebug for coverage)

pit.install: add the pitest-maven plugin (org.pitest:pitest-maven) or the Gradle plugin info.solidsoft.pitest to the build, then run mvn org.pitest:pitest-maven:mutationCoverage or gradle pitest
